name: tourist-safety
description: Smart Tourist Safety Monitoring & Incident Response System (MCA mini project)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix blockchain
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run compile --prefix blockchain && npm test --prefix blockchain && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.render-build: npm ci --include=dev && npm ci --include=dev --prefix backend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix blockchain && npm run chain:compile && npm run build
